opening.text: I've come in because I have chest pain even when I'm resting, and my symptoms get worse when I exert myself and ease off when I rest. I should mention that I smoke cigarettes, and I've had a spontaneous pneumothorax, or collapsed lung, before. Someone in my family has had a pneumothorax as well.
